uyeler.baslik: Christa Pike survives a failed execution in Tennessee and remains in critical condition

Her defence has asked Governor Bill Lee to commute her sentence. Pike, 50, was given both doses of pentobarbital set out in the state protocol — two 50-millilitre syringes — at Riverbend Maximum Security Institution in Nashville. Witnesses said she was still breathing and could be heard snoring nearly an hour later, when they were escorted out of the room. She was taken by ambulance to a nearby hospital.
